entries.name: Measurement Always Yields Deterministic |0>
entries.faulty_rule: Belief that measuring a superposition always produces outcome |0>
entries.student_prompt_template: What will be the outcome when you measure qubit q[0] after applying an H gate?
hint_ladder: What quantum state is created when an H gate acts on |0>?
Look at the amplitudes of |0> and |1> in the state vector. Are they non-zero?
How does the Born rule relate probability to amplitude magnitudes?
The Hadamard gate creates state (|0> + |1>)/sqrt(2), so measurement yields |0> 50% of the time and |1> 50% of the time.

remediation_experiment.title: Run 1000 Shots on Hadamard State
remediation_experiment.description: Simulate measuring |+> state 1000 times to observe the 50/50 statistical distribution.

entries.name: Superposition Equals Classical Probabilistic Mixture
entries.faulty_rule: Confusing quantum superposition with classical probabilistic mixture, missing phase effects
entries.student_prompt_template: What state results from applying two successive Hadamard gates to |0>?
hint_ladder: What operation does a second Hadamard gate perform on a superposition state?
What are the probability amplitudes for each computational path when H is applied twice?
Do the probability amplitudes from different paths add constructively or destructively?
Applying H twice yields H(H|0>) = I|0> = |0> deterministically due to quantum interference, unlike classical random choice.

remediation_experiment.title: H-H Interference Test
remediation_experiment.description: Compare classical coin flipping twice vs applying two Hadamard gates.

entries.name: Hadamard Gate is Pauli-X Bit Flip
entries.faulty_rule: Thinking H gate is identical to Pauli X bit-flip gate
entries.student_prompt_template: Does the H gate simply flip |0> to |1>?
hint_ladder: How does the matrix representation of an H gate differ from a Pauli-X gate?
Where does the state H|0> lie on the Bloch sphere compared to X|0>?
Does the H gate produce a single basis state or a linear combination?
Hadamard maps |0> to (|0>+|1>)/sqrt(2), whereas Pauli-X maps |0> directly to |1>.

remediation_experiment.title: Statevector Blochsphere Comparison
remediation_experiment.description: Plot Bloch vectors for X|0> vs H|0>.

entries.name: Grover Oracle Uses Bit-Flip Instead of Phase-Flip
entries.faulty_rule: Using X/CNOT directly in Grover oracle without phase kickback target |->
entries.student_prompt_template: Why does a raw CNOT without target state |-> fail to act as a Grover oracle?
hint_ladder: How does Grover's search algorithm mark target computational basis states?
Should an oracle modify measurement probabilities or state vector phases?
What state must the target qubit be in for a CNOT gate to cause phase kickback?
The oracle must invert the sign (phase) of target state |x_target>, not flip basis bits directly.

remediation_experiment.title: Compare CNOT vs CZ / Phase Kickback
remediation_experiment.description: Measure state vector signs after applying raw CNOT vs CNOT with target in |->.

entries.name: Single Qubit Z Gate Used as Multi-Qubit Oracle
entries.faulty_rule: Applying single-qubit Z gate as an oracle instead of controlled phase flip across multi-qubits
entries.student_prompt_template: Does Z on q[0] flip the sign of marked multi-qubit state |11> exclusively?
hint_ladder: Which computational basis states are affected when Z is applied to qubit 0?
Does single-qubit Z change the sign of states other than the target state?
What type of controlled gate is required to target a specific multi-qubit basis state?
Multi-qubit state marking requires controlled-phase operations (like CZ) to target a specific joint state.

remediation_experiment.title: Statevector Phase Inspection
remediation_experiment.description: Compare amplitudes of Z(q0)|11> and CZ(q0,q1)|11>.

entries.name: CNOT in Oracle Omits Target Hadamard Gate
entries.faulty_rule: Omitting Hadamard on target ancilla qubit before CNOT in oracle construction
entries.student_prompt_template: What happens if you run CNOT into an ancilla in |0> instead of |->?
hint_ladder: What state is the ancilla target qubit initialized to before the oracle CNOT?
How does the output state of CNOT change if the target is in |0> vs |->?
Which single-qubit gate transforms basis state |1> into phase-kickback state |->?
Without initial H (and final H) on ancilla initialized to |1>, phase kickback (-1)^f(x) does not occur.

remediation_experiment.title: Phase Kickback Ancilla Verification
remediation_experiment.description: Trace state amplitudes with ancilla initialized to |0> vs X then H.

entries.name: CNOT Copies Quantum State (No-Cloning Violation)
entries.faulty_rule: CNOT copies quantum state from control to target qubit, creating independent duplicates
entries.student_prompt_template: Does CNOT(0,1) acting on (|0>+|1>)/sqrt(2) x |0> create two independent |+> states?
hint_ladder: What is the joint statevector after applying CNOT to H|0> tensor |0>?
How does the joint state vector compare to a separable product state?
Can a joint quantum state be factored into separate individual qubit states?
Due to the No-Cloning Theorem, CNOT entangles the qubits rather than creating an independent copy.

remediation_experiment.title: Entanglement vs Product State Comparison
remediation_experiment.description: Calculate reduced state purity for (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2) (purity 0.5) vs (|0>+|1>)(|0>+|1>)/2 (purity 1.0).

entries.name: Measurement Has No Effect on State
entries.faulty_rule: Measurement does not collapse state vector or destroy quantum superposition
entries.student_prompt_template: What happens if you insert a Z-basis measurement between two H gates?
hint_ladder: What happens to a quantum state vector when a projective Z-basis measurement occurs?
If state |+> collapses to |0> or |1>, what state does a subsequent H gate produce?
Does measuring mid-circuit preserve or destroy quantum superposition?
Measurement collapses superposition into a basis state, so H after measurement yields a 50/50 mixture instead of pure |0>.

remediation_experiment.title: Mid-Circuit Measurement Test
remediation_experiment.description: Compare output of H-H vs H-Measure-H.

entries.name: Local Phase Gate Alters Entanglement Entropy
entries.faulty_rule: Applying Z gate to one qubit of a Bell pair alters its entanglement entropy
entries.student_prompt_template: Does applying a local Z gate on q[0] change the entanglement entropy of the Bell state (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2)?
hint_ladder: What state is produced when a local Z gate acts on qubit 0 of an entangled state?
What is the reduced density matrix for qubit 0 before and after the Z gate?
Do local unitary operations change the eigenvalues of the reduced density matrix?
Local unitaries change relative phase but preserve entanglement entropy S(rho_A) = 1 bit.

remediation_experiment.title: Entanglement Entropy Calculation
remediation_experiment.description: Compute S(rho_A) for (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2) vs (|00>-|11>)/sqrt(2); both equal 1.0.

entries.name: Grover Search Over-Iteration
entries.faulty_rule: Running Grover iterations N times instead of optimal pi/4 * sqrt(N) times
entries.student_prompt_template: What happens to target state probability if you double the optimal Grover iteration count?
hint_ladder: How does the quantum state vector rotate in the 2D subspace during each Grover iteration?
What happens to the state vector angle if you rotate past 90 degrees?
Is the target state probability monotonic or periodic with respect to iteration count?
Grover search is periodic; over-iterating reduces target state probability as the vector rotates back away from the target.

remediation_experiment.title: Grover Probability vs Iterations Plot
remediation_experiment.description: Plot target state probability P(target) as a function of iteration count.

entries.name: VQE Zero Parameter Initialization Lockout
entries.faulty_rule: Initializing VQE rotation parameters to all zeros gets stuck at zero gradient or saddle point
entries.student_prompt_template: Why can initializing all Ry parameters in a VQE ansatz to theta=0 cause gradient descent optimization to stagnate?
hint_ladder: What state vector is prepared by Ry(theta) when theta = 0.0?
How does the energy gradient dE/dtheta behave at a symmetric zero-parameter state?
Will gradient descent step away from a state where all parameter gradients evaluate to zero?
Zero-parameter initialization can lock optimization in local extrema or zero-gradient regions; small random initialization avoids this.

remediation_experiment.title: VQE Energy Gradient Evaluation
remediation_experiment.description: Compute energy gradients at theta=[0,0] vs theta=[0.1, 0.05].
